alt: A window of fixed size sliding one position at a time around a circular array, dropping the element that leaves and adding the element that enters at each step, including windows that wrap past the last index, ending on the window with the largest sum.

steps.caption: Start with the window at position 0: values[0] through values[2], summing to 8.
Slide to position 1: drop values[0] = 4, add values[3] = 2. New sum: 6.
Slide to position 2: drop values[1] = -1, add values[4] = -3. New sum: 4.
Slide to position 3: drop values[2] = 5, add values[5] = 6. New sum: 5.
Slide to position 4: drop values[3] = 2, add values[0] = 4. New sum: 7. The window has wrapped past the last index.
Slide to position 5: drop values[4] = -3, add values[1] = -1. New sum: 9. The window has wrapped past the last index. That beats the best sum so far, now 9.
Every one of the 6 starting positions is checked, wrapped ones included. The best window starts at position 5 with sum 9.
Start with the window at position 0: values[0] through values[3], summing to 10.
Slide to position 1: drop values[0] = 1, add values[0] = 1. New sum: 10.
Slide to position 2: drop values[1] = 2, add values[1] = 2. New sum: 10.
Slide to position 3: drop values[2] = 3, add values[2] = 3. New sum: 10.
Every one of the 4 starting positions is checked, wrapped ones included. The best window starts at position 0 with sum 10.
Start with the window at position 0: values[0] through values[0], summing to 3.
Slide to position 1: drop values[0] = 3, add values[1] = -2. New sum: -2.
Slide to position 2: drop values[1] = -2, add values[2] = 7. New sum: 7. That beats the best sum so far, now 7.
Slide to position 3: drop values[2] = 7, add values[3] = 0. New sum: 0.
Slide to position 4: drop values[3] = 0, add values[4] = 1. New sum: 1.
Every one of the 5 starting positions is checked, wrapped ones included. The best window starts at position 2 with sum 7.
